staffing_automation.source_record: The calendar record whose title exactly matches calendar_anchor.unique_title
staffing_automation.derivation: For each Tuesday, the primary-to-secondary on-call handoff is generated at the anchor review end time.
staffing_automation.master_change_behavior: A time change to the source record becomes the weekly anchor for the target week and later weeks.
staffing_automation.occurrence_exception_behavior: A dated exception must be created in the staffing scheduler and linked to confirmed coverage before the matching calendar occurrence is changed.
staffing_automation.calendar_event_matching: The calendar title alone does not identify a dated exception or expose recurrence state.

scheduler_access.occurrence_exception_interface: Not available through the Calendar task interface
scheduler_access.coverage_confirmation_interface: Not available through the Calendar task interface
